releaseNotes:
v0.9.96

Quick fixes
- Recorder no longer saves your own whispers, including the 2nd welcome whisper you send.
- Automatic whisper replies now find the person from the room list, so they actually send. The reply counter still moves forward even if a send fails.
- Welcome and 2nd Message Add / Update now work the same way as Answering Settings: pick a line, edit, Update keeps it selected so you can change it again. Add writes a new line and clears the box.

Settings files
Older versions stored welcome texts, triggers, console notices, and answering replies in many separate files. Companion now keeps all of that together. The previous update copied those old files into the new store, so leftover sample lines could come along. This version does not copy old files. What you already saved stays. If you want a clean start with the new sample messages, close Companion and delete companion.db in your IMVUCompanion folder. Your IMVU login is not in that file. Later updates will keep what you created.

Coming next
In-app global settings. First on the list: reset the whole settings store, or only the parts you choose.
